name: AI Influencer
intro: AI Influencer is the SmartVideo studio for designing a consistent virtual character, built from your reference photo, picture options and a style preset.

features.your-photo-reference-upload: Start with Your Photo. Upload a reference photo or video, or browse stock photos from Pexels. Your character is built from this image, so pick a clear one.
features.visual-attributes-face-body-style-tabs: Visual Attributes has Face, Body and Style tabs full of picture cards. Click one option in each category to shape your character in detail, without writing a long prompt.
features.shuffle-and-reset: Shuffle picks a random option in every category when you want ideas. Reset clears every choice, so your photo and text do the work alone.
features.style-preset: Style Preset gives you twenty one-click looks, with Realistic as the default. Pick one chip to set the overall mood of your character.
features.output-format: Output Format matches your portrait to the platform, from an Instagram post to a story, a YouTube thumbnail or a Pinterest pin. Quick ratio buttons sit above the preview.
features.style-intensity-and-seed-lock-advanced: In the Advanced panel, Style Intensity strengthens or softens the style, and Seed lock helps you repeat a look you like.
features.additional-instructions: Additional instructions is an optional text box where you add a pose, an outfit, a setting or a mood.
features.history-strip: The history strip keeps your earlier characters, so you can compare them and download the ones you like.

outro: That's the tour of AI Influencer. Build a look from pictures, add your own touches, and keep one character consistent across everything you share.
